prompt: Колега відкрив PR з новим модулем digests (файли в evals/fixtures/digests-layering/server/src/modules/digests/). Подивись його на структуру перед мержем: що не так з точки зору того, як у нас мають бути розкладені шари на сервері, і як це виправити? Дай список проблем з файлом і рядком та план виправлення.

assertions.text: Flags that routes.ts imports drizzle-orm / db schema and queries container.db directly
Flags the blocked-ratio -> 'urgent'/'routine' business rule living in the route handler and proposes a pure function for it
Flags manual CreateDigestBody.parse(req.body) and proposes declaring it as schema.body on the route
Flags that DigestsService takes the whole Container and proposes narrow Deps
Flags that the service imports drizzle-orm / db schema and proposes a repository
Flags that the service imports FastifyReply / calls reply.code and proposes throwing an AppError subclass (NotFoundError)
Flags that the service constructs concrete adapters (OctokitGitHubClient / AnthropicProvider) itself and proposes getting them through the container/ports
Flags reading API keys from process.env in the service (secrets must go through the container / SecretsProvider)
Flags that getOne and/or deliver load a digest by id without workspaceId scoping
Mentions running pnpm arch:check (and not growing the baseline) as verification
